algorithm.title: Benzodiazepine toxicity and delirium in the elderly

nodes.text: Screen elderly patients presenting with new confusion + dysarthria + cerebellar ataxia
Review medication list: identify sedatives, hypnotics, and benzodiazepines (temazepam)
First-line action: gradually taper and discontinue temazepam to prevent severe withdrawal
**Acute severe sedation with respiratory depression:** supportive care; avoid flumazenil in chronic users
**Persistent cognitive deficits after drug washout:** obtain MRI brain and formal neuropsychological testing
Offer nonpharmacologic sleep hygiene and cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia
